name: Front page shows the live watch without signing in
description: The public landing page loads signed out, with its headline, the live watch card read from the recorder, the eight watched regions, the newest case and the numbers on file.

planSteps.description: Assert the main heading reads "Ships are crossing the world's cables right now." and the URL path is still / (no redirect to sign in)

Assert the live watch card (data-testid recorder-status) is shown with a data-state of recording, failing, stale, never-ran or unreachable, and that unless it is unreachable its ship count (data-testid recorder-ships) is a whole number
Assert the region list (data-testid live-regions) holds exactly 8 items, each with a data-state of heard or quiet, and that one of them reads Gulf of Finland

Assert the newest case (data-testid latest-cases) holds one case card whose data-testid starts with case-card-, the figures row (data-testid landing-numbers) shows 4 figures, and the evidence card (data-testid landing-evidence) quotes Cinia
